# Truth and Method

*[Gadamer](../philosophers/gadamer.md) · 1960 · *Wahrheit und Methode**

[Gadamer](../philosophers/gadamer.md)'s major work, which founded [philosophical hermeneutics](../movements/hermeneutics.md): starting from art, history and language, it shows that understanding is an event of tradition rather than the application of a method.
